themes.label: AI manipulation, hate speech, disinformation
themes.definition: Concern that AI and cyberspace enable disinformation, hate speech and manipulation of human behaviour and thought, threatening democracies.
themes.inclusion: Include passages on AI manipulating behaviour or thoughts, or AI-linked disinformation and hate speech threatening democracy.
themes.exclusion: Exclude hate-speech concerns with no AI or technology link.
themes.boundary_cases: 'AI must serve humans' phrasing is also coded AI_HUMAN_RIGHTS_ETHICS.

examples.quote: Artificial intelligence must serve humans and not manipulate their behaviour and thoughts.

themes.label: Common rules for cyberspace
themes.definition: Call for common international rules so cyberspace (including AI) does not get out of hand and destroy democracies.
themes.inclusion: Include calls for common rules governing AI or cyberspace.
themes.boundary_cases: Rules framed for cyberspace generally are coded here only when AI is discussed in the same passage.

examples.quote: It is high time that we manage to set common rules so that cyberspace does not get out of hand

value.rationale: A short Monaco 2022 passage links AI to manipulation, disinformation and democratic harm and calls for common rules for cyberspace.
